赵霸人如其名，那真的是村子里的一霸！！

可以说，这家伙就是个坏种，从小坏到大的，从小就把同龄人打的嗷嗷叫，去踹寡妇门，欺负人家小媳妇，村子里保山家里的羊吃了赵霸家的稻苗，赵霸二话不说去了保山家中，狠狠打了保山一顿不说，还把人家的羊给宰了拎回去吃肉。

说什么，你家羊吃了我家的庄稼，我就得吃了你得羊。

这只羊，那可是保山家准备卖了娶媳妇的，当初买羊宰子的钱，也是一半借来的，老爹奈何不了赵霸，被气的一命呜呼，升天了。

老娘当时三十多岁，在赵霸他爹的忽悠下直接改嫁了，其中肯定没少收男方的好处费，当时的保山也才十六七岁，好在是个男丁，倒是没有被吃了绝户，要是个女孩子的话，恐怕保山也难逃厄运，早就被忽悠着嫁人卖了。

直到现在，保山见到赵霸打心里犯怵，一味的躲藏。

还有去年的时候，在老林子里面糟蹋了人家去采榛子的年轻姑娘，这姑娘可是刚刚结婚才一个月，等到丈夫发现的时候，自家媳妇已经被糟蹋完了，但是没有证据啊，赵霸这个家伙还有同伴打掩护，有不在场的证明。

只能不了了之了。

谁知道，这被糟蹋的姑娘竟然怀上了孩子，被婆家赶出了家门，天黑路滑还下雨，掉到河沟里面一尸两命了，这下更是死无对证了。

赵霸这些年的恶事，可是没少干。

但是大家都拿他没办法，这不是几年前就看上了王春晓，在村里扬言王春晓是他的媳妇，谁要是敢上门说亲，就揍死谁。

这不，还真没人敢打王春晓的主意了。

王守业没办法，只能想着和赵支书家联姻，至少也算是有个照顾。

至于赵霸此人。

身高不过一米六，但是一身的腱子肉，为人蛮横，双目凶狠，天生的就是恶人相，从小开始就能够吃饱饭，吃好饭，这身子才能长得这么壮硕。

平日里，大家都吃不饱的，身子都发育不良，干瘦得很。

虽然赵霸长得矮，但是身子壮硕，大家也打不过他，人家背后还有老爹是赵支书，乡里也有人啊！！

与村子里的李虎，称为石溪村双恶霸！

这不，大家刚刚说完赵支书家里的坏话，在听到赵霸的声音在旁边响起的时候，一个个被吓得面色煞白，眼神中更满是惊恐。

特别是栓柱，背后的凉风直窜！

“赵，赵霸来了啊！”

“这怎么走路还没声呢！”

栓柱暗自咽了口口水，见赵霸还一直盯着自己，只得开口道：“我们也只是道听途说然后分析的，当不得真，当不得真……！”

“啪！”

栓柱还没说完，赵霸的巴掌便落在栓柱的脸上了，这一巴掌可是重的很，栓柱立刻就感觉头晕眼花，眼前直冒小星星，一屁股坐到在地上，这要是检查一下，估计也得是个轻微脑震荡了。

周围村民望着眼前一幕直打怵！

赵霸见到周围人的反应，倒是十分满意，弯腰抓住栓柱的领子将其硬生生从地上给拽了起来，眼神中满是怒火道：“刚刚的事情，都是真的，有哪些是你胡编乱造的？”

“快说！”

栓柱被吓得双腿发软，急忙道：“这，这李青山送了王春晓成品衣是真的，当时王春晓跟着李青山从老林子一起回来，这也是真的啊，至于到底在老林子里面发生了什么，那我就不知道了。”

“啪！”

又是一道清脆的巴掌声响起，赵霸满脸阴鸠道：“这件事情，谁要是再敢乱传，我弄死他。”

说罢。

丢下早已被吓软腿的栓柱，朝着家中走去，但脸上的戾气却越发浓烈，他要回家一趟，问问自己老爹村里的情况，几天不在村子里，没想到竟然发生了这种事情。

还有李青山这个小鳖孙子。

从小就是被自己打到大的，竟然敢招惹自己的女人？

说实话，赵霸是有些不敢相信的。

你要说李虎敢沾染自己的女人，赵霸倒是有些相信。

李青山？

这软王八，怎么敢的？

赵支书因为今天的事情，心情十分不佳，正坐在院子里喝着闷酒，想着如何惩治一番这李青山，不能让这小子这么嚣张下去了。

“爹，村子里这两天发生什么事了吗？”

赵霸推门走了进来，将刚刚在村口听到的事情告知了赵支书，面色阴沉。

“八九不离十吧！”

“但是王春晓有没有被李青山这货糟蹋不知道，但两个人之间肯定是有问题的。”

赵支书便将今日的事情，又和自家儿子说了一遍，包括李青山给王春晓买了裙子，王春晓穿裙子去给李青山看的场面，旋即道：“我这不是在想点子，怎么教训教训这小子一顿吗。”

“啪！”

赵霸一巴掌拍在桌子上，脸上流露出一抹怒色道：“爹，遇到这种事情，还有什么点子好想的，直接去这小子家里揍这小子一顿不就是了？”

“至于王春晓有没有被这小子糟蹋，也用不着这么麻烦，过几天我找个机会，亲自试一试不就行了？”

“你这孩子，干什么都这么冲动，要用脑子，要用谋略，匹夫之勇要不得，懂不懂？”

赵支书见状，眉头紧皱道。

“爹，你就是婆婆妈妈，这事情哪有这么麻烦，我先出去一趟。”

赵霸说完。

也不等赵支书说完，便直接迈着步子走出门去，直奔王守业家中而去。

“这孩子，怎么这么冲动！”

赵支书望着自家儿子离开，皱了皱眉头，却并未阻止，有的时候也需要自家儿子的武力，去解决一些问题，反正只要不打死人，就不会出现什么大问题。

赵霸一脚踹开王守业家中大门，迈着粗短的双腿便走了进去，王守业正在家中忙活着整理农具，还未反应过来，就被一脚踹倒在地上。

一个狗啃屎，狼狈不堪。

还未来得及反应过来，便感觉雨点一般的拳脚不断落在身上，发出一道道沉闷声响。

“老东西，纵容你闺女在外面不三不四，勾搭别的男人，震荡我赵霸好欺负的是不是？”

“欠揍的老狗，老子今天弄死你。”

“娘的，欠揍的东西，真欠揍……！”

赵霸一边说着，一边对着王守业拳打脚踢，那是真的动手打，疼的王守业是哎呦哎呦个不停。

“赵霸，赵霸你这是干什么，你打我做什么？”

“快，别打了，别打了，我这把老骨头唉……疼死了……救命啊……救命哎……！”

王守业被打的连连求饶，自家婆娘和儿子纷纷走出屋来，急忙上去拉开赵霸，谁成想这赵霸也没想放过王守业的儿子和婆娘，抡起拳脚就对着这母子打了过去。

王守业家中的动静，逐渐引起了周围邻居的注意！

纷纷走出家门，好奇的站在王守业大门外朝着里面瞥，在看到里面是赵霸在揍人后，便不敢进去了。

Zhao Ba lives up to his name, he is really a tyrant in the village!!

It can be said that this guy is a bad guy. He has been bad since he was a child. He beat his peers until he was young, kicked down the widow's door, and bullied his wife. In the village, Baoshan's sheep ate rice seedlings from Zhao Ba's family. Zhao Ba went to Baoshan's house without saying a word, beat Baoshan severely without saying a word, and slaughtered other people's sheep and took them back to eat meat.

What do you mean, if your sheep eat my crops, I will have to eat your sheep.

This sheep was one that the Baoshan family was going to sell to marry a wife. Half of the money they spent to buy the sheep to slaughter was borrowed. Zhao Ba couldn't do anything about it, so his father was so angry that he died and ascended to heaven.

My mother was in her thirties at the time, and she remarried directly under the deception of Zhao Ba's father, who must have received a lot of benefits from the man. Baoshan was only sixteen or seventeen years old at the time. Fortunately, he was a boy, so he was not deprived of his family. If it had been a girl, Baoshan would not have been able to escape the same fate, and he would have been deceived into marrying and selling her off.

Until now, Baoshan was terrified when he saw Zhao Ba and kept hiding.

And last year, he raped a young girl who went to pick hazelnuts in the old forest. This girl had just been married for only a month. By the time her husband found out, his wife had already been raped, but there was no evidence. This guy Zhao Ba had a companion to cover him up and had an alibi.

We can only let it go.

Who would have known that this ruined girl would actually be pregnant with a child, and was kicked out of the house by her husband's family. It was dark, slippery, and raining, and she fell into a ditch, killing one and two people. This time, there was no evidence of her death.

Zhao Ba has done a lot of bad things over the years.

但是大家都拿他没办法，这不是几年前就看上了王春晓，在村里扬言王春晓是他的媳妇，谁要是敢上门说亲，就揍死谁。

No, no one really dares to take Wang Chunxiao's idea.

Wang Shouye had no choice but to marry into the Zhao family, at least to have someone take care of him.

As for Zhao Ba.

He is only 1.6 meters tall, but he is full of tendons. He is arrogant, has fierce eyes, and is born to be evil. He has been able to eat well and eat well since he was a child, so he can grow so strong.

On weekdays, everyone does not have enough to eat, and their bodies are stunted and very thin.

Although Zhao Ba is short, he is strong and no one can beat him. Behind him, his father is the Party Secretary Zhao, and there are people in the village!!

and Li Hu in the village, known as the twin bullies of Shixi Village!

No, everyone had just finished speaking ill of Party Secretary Zhao's family. When they heard Zhao Ba's voice ringing nearby, they all turned pale with fright, and their eyes were even more frightened.

Especially Shuan Zhu, the cool breeze blows straight behind him!

"Zhao, Zhao Ba is here!"

"Why are you walking without making any sound?"

Shuan Zhu swallowed secretly and saw that Zhao Ba was still staring at him, so he had to say: "We just heard about it and then analyzed it. We can't take it as true, we can't take it as true...!"

"Crack!"

Before Shuan Zhu finished speaking, Zhao Ba's slap fell on Shuan Zhu's face. This slap was very heavy. Shuan Zhu immediately felt dizzy, with little stars appearing in front of his eyes, and he sat down on the ground. If he checked, he probably had a slight concussion.

The surrounding villagers were horrified at the scene in front of them!

Zhao Ba was very satisfied when he saw the reactions of the people around him. He bent down and grabbed Shuan Zhu by his collar and pulled him up from the ground. His eyes were filled with anger and he said, "What happened just now is all true. Which of them are you just making up?"

"Say it quickly!"

Shuan Zhu was so frightened that his legs became weak and he hurriedly said: "Well, it is true that Li Qingshan gave Wang Chunxiao finished clothes. At that time, Wang Chunxiao followed Li Qingshan back from the old forest. This is also true. As for what happened in the old forest, I don't know."

"Crack!"

Another crisp slap sounded, and Zhao Ba said with a sinister look on his face: "If anyone dares to spread this matter again, I will kill him."

Say it.

He left Zhuan Zhu, whose legs were weak from fear, and walked towards his home, but the anger on his face became more and more intense. He wanted to go home and ask his father about the situation in the village. He had not been in the village for a few days, but he did not expect that such a thing would happen.

And Li Qingshan, the little turtle grandson.

He has been beaten by me since he was a child, but he dares to provoke his own woman?

To be honest, Zhao Ba couldn't believe it.

If you say that Li Hu dares to touch his own woman, Zhao Ba would somewhat believe it.

Li Qingshan?

How dare this weak bastard do this?

Party Secretary Zhao was in a very bad mood because of what happened today. He was sitting in the yard drinking wine, thinking about how to punish Li Qingshan. He could not let this kid continue to be so arrogant.

"Dad, what happened in the village these two days?"

Zhao Ba opened the door and walked in, telling Party Secretary Zhao what he had just heard at the entrance of the village, his face gloomy.

"It's almost like ten!"

"But I don't know if Wang Chunxiao has been ruined by Li Qingshan, but there must be problems between the two of them."

Secretary Zhao told his son what happened today, including the scene where Li Qingshan bought a skirt for Wang Chunxiao and Wang Chunxiao wore the skirt to show it to Li Qingshan. He then said, "I'm thinking of some ideas on how to teach this kid a lesson."

"Crack!"

Zhao Ba slapped the table with his hand, and said with a look of anger on his face: "Dad, if you encounter this kind of thing, do you have any other ideas? Why don't you just go to this kid's house and beat him up?"

"As for whether Wang Chunxiao has been ruined by this kid, there is no need to bother. I can find a chance in a few days to try it myself."

"You kid, you are so impulsive in everything you do. You have to use your brain and strategy. You need the courage of an ordinary man. Do you understand?"

When Secretary Zhao saw this, he frowned.

"Dad, you are my mother-in-law. How can this matter be so troublesome? I'll go out first."

Zhao Ba finished speaking.

Without waiting for Party Secretary Zhao to finish speaking, he walked out the door and headed straight for Wang Shouye's home.

"Why is this kid so impulsive!"

Secretary Zhao watched his son leave and frowned, but did not stop him. Sometimes his son's force was needed to solve some problems. Anyway, as long as no one was killed, there would be no big problems.

Zhao Ba kicked open the door of Wang Shouye's house and walked in with his stubby legs. Wang Shouye was busy arranging farm tools at home. Before he could react, he was kicked to the ground.

A dog is chewing shit and is in a miserable state.

Before he could react, he felt fists and kicks falling like raindrops on his body, making dull sounds one after another.

"Old man, if you allow your daughter to be shady outside and hook up with other men, it will make me, Zhao Ba, easy to bully, right?"

"You old dog who deserves a beating, I will kill you today."

"Damn, you deserve a beating, you really deserve a beating...!"

As Zhao Ba said this, he punched and kicked Wang Shouye. It was a real beating, and Wang Shouye was so painful that he kept moaning and groaning.

"Zhao Ba, Zhao Ba, what are you doing? Why are you hitting me?"

"Quick, stop hitting, stop hitting, my old bones... it hurts so much... help... help...!"

Wang Shouye was beaten repeatedly and begged for mercy. His mother-in-law and son came out of the house one after another and hurriedly went up to pull Zhao Ba away. Unexpectedly, Zhao Ba did not want to let Wang Shouye's son and mother-in-law go. He hit the mother and son with his fists and kicks.

The movements in Wang Shouye's home gradually attracted the attention of the surrounding neighbors!

They all walked out of the house, curiously stood outside Wang Shouye's gate and glanced inside. After seeing Zhao Ba beating someone inside, they didn't dare to go in.
